title: Cartwise Shopper Batches Mileage Approval Share by Violation Points
content:
When a mileage adjustment is approved on a Cartwise Shopper Batches batch, the claimed amount is first multiplied by the mileage approval share, which follows the active violation points on the shopper's Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts record:

| Active violation points | Mileage approval share |
|---|---|
| None | 1.00 |
| One to three | 0.95 |
| Four or more | 0.90 |

The points are the account's active violation points balance at the time of handling.

## Hypothetical figures

| Claimed amount | Active points | After the share |
|---|---|---|
| 4.00 | 0 | 4.00 |
| 4.00 | 3 | 4.00 multiplied by 0.95 is 3.80 |
| 4.00 | 4 | 4.00 multiplied by 0.90 is 3.60 |
